# Indus Valley script research knowledge base

> Source-linked research on the Indus script and its archaeology. Complete object records and metadata are the first priority. The script remains undeciphered.

- [README](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/index.html): purpose, findings and ways to explore.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/k-sandhu/indus-valley-script/blob/feb2061f1c880b0817137417f4f36bda62795b1b/AGENTS.md): agent rules and task routes.
- [Findings guide](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/findings/index.html): measured results by subject.
- [Working model](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/working-model/index.html): current claims and deciding tests.
- [Conjectures](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/conjectures/rules.html): claims, credences and predictions.
- [Questions](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/questions/index.html): open research and data tasks.
- [Data coverage](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/data.html): sources, gaps and priorities.
- [Repository map](https://github.com/k-sandhu/indus-valley-script/blob/feb2061f1c880b0817137417f4f36bda62795b1b/knowledge/MAP.md): navigation through the knowledge base.
- [Attempt registry](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/attempts/index.html): earlier work and retry conditions.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://k-sandhu.github.io/indus-valley-script/contribute/index.html): ownership and review.
- [LOCAL_STORAGE.md](https://github.com/k-sandhu/indus-valley-script/blob/feb2061f1c880b0817137417f4f36bda62795b1b/LOCAL_STORAGE.md): local input storage and restoration.
